primary.title: Gold Holds Gain as Trump’s War Comments Ease Inflation Jitters
primary.summary: Gold held a gain as US President Donald Trump appeared to rule out prolonged military action in the Middle East, easing inflationary concerns driven by a renewed spike in energy prices.
